profile.description: 2026-or-future provider opportunity discovered while filling the leg manager's post-Labor-Day route. The 2026 festival already advertises inflatables and family activities, so outreach should respectfully ask whether anything is still open this year while also introducing Adventure Zone for 2027/future events.

notes.subject: 2026/future provider opportunity - Boise Fall Festival
notes.body: 2026 Boise Fall Festival is Saturday Sept. 12, 10 AM-4 PM at Expo Idaho, 5610 N Glenwood St, Boise ID. Current official event information already advertises inflatables, face painting, pony rides and other family activities. Outreach should not assume the current lineup is closed to us: ask whether they still have room or a need this year and explain the prepaid model clearly: the event pays the package fee and guests can enjoy the attractions at no charge. If 2026 is already set, ask to be considered for 2027 or another IBL-produced event. Pay-for-play can remain a secondary option if appropriate. No Adventure Zone Gmail history was found for this event.

followUps.label: Boise 2026/future follow-up
followUps.reason: If there is still room in 2026, lead with prepaid so guests play free; if this year's entertainment is already set, keep the conversation open for 2027 or another IBL event.
